name: Microlink Solutions Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有公告任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。主要事项为循环关联交易授权的更新、集资活动以及公司秘书与提名与薪酬委员会的变动。
overview_en: This year the company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal or new contract for its business segments. The main items were the renewal of the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, fund-raising exercises, and changes in company secretaries and the nomination and remuneration committee.
